description: Aider-polyglot style (Kotlin): implement a variable-length quantity codec for unsigned 32-bit values from a stub and an instructions file. The byte order is least significant group first (the opposite of the textbook big-endian layout, so a memorised solution fails), and decoding must reject incomplete streams, values above 32 bits, sixth bytes and non-minimal encodings. A plain Kotlin test runner compiled by run_tests.py is the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier runs it, so a failing first attempt gets a repair round with the output.
